title: Postings Compression Essentials: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Postings Compression Essentials: Visual Guide

1. From Postings To Gaps | the sorted postings you already intersect, shown beside their gaps, with sliders for corpus size and term density driving bits per posting and total list size | gaps scale with density (mean gap at most N/df) and not with corpus size, so the absolute-ID bar grows with N while the gap bar does not move, and total size is document frequency times bits per gap

2. Decoding The Gap Stream | a step-by-step decode of doc gaps, term frequencies and position gaps, switchable between a clean stream, one corrupted gap and out-of-order IDs | decoding is a prefix sum so one damaged gap shifts every later document ID, positions reset per document and term frequency delimits them, and an out-of-order ID makes a negative gap that most postings codes cannot represent

3. Seven Bits Per Byte | a variable-byte encoder showing base-128 groups, marker bits and payload bits for any value, with presets at 127, 128, 16383 and 16384 | byte count is max(1, ceil(bitlen/7)) and steps at 128 and 16,384 rather than sliding, the marker bit is a fixed one-in-eight tax, and an outlier costs more bytes without widening its neighbours

4. Ratio Versus Latency | four codecs over one block of 128 gaps with an outlier slider, an exceptions toggle and three read patterns (hot cached, cold network, monthly archive) | the densest codec loses on hot postings because decode CPU dominates and it surrenders skip granularity, a fixed-width pack without exceptions widens all 128 values to fit one outlier, and only the archive case makes bytes the right metric

5. Postings Or Parquet | nine aligned rows comparing search postings with a Parquet column, marked shared or differing, plus a workload chooser that recommends a codec | delta, dictionary and run-length are genuinely the same transforms on both sides, and it is grain, navigation metadata, access path and objective that differ — so a hot term list wants a block integer codec with restart points while a cold archival column justifies stronger Zstd
